description: The ultralight and durable 20″ mountain bike with front suspension, 9 gears and disc brakes designed for children aged 6 years and over.

components.description: Chromoly axle and sealed industrial ball bearings
Hydraulic disc brakes by Promax; Rotor diameter front/back: 140/140 mm; Ergonomic brake levers designed for a child’s hands
Cassette with 11-32 teeth in the back
Narrow-wide chainring with 28 teeth in the front
Lightweight, forged aluminum, 4.3" (110 mm), kid-specific cranks with narrow tread (Q-factor)
SRAM X5 rear derailleur
RST SPEX hydraulic air suspension fork with 60 mm travel, adjustable compression, and rebound damping, plus lock-out; 1 – 1 ⅛″ tapered steerer tube; 100 x 15 mm thru axle; Post mount for disc brake
Child-friendly because of a small diameter; Single-clamp grip to prevent twisting; Safety zone: extra rubber on the palm-facing portion of the grip for added comfort; 100% silicone for maximum grip
Wide, ergonomically adapted and lightweight aluminum bars for more control; Tapered end to fit a child’s hand; Sandblasted and silver anodized; Width: 570 mm; Rise: 20 mm
Fully integrated 1 – 1 ⅛" headset; Sealed industrial bearings
4 mm hex key for the stem and seatpost clamp; 8 mm hex key for the front wheel and pedals
Flat pedals made from fiber-reinforced nylon
Ergonomically designed to fit a child’s anatomy; Streamlined, mountain-bike-specific saddle design; Side protection to lean against walls
27.2 x 250 mm; Anodized aluminum seatpost with insertion marks that indicate the minimum insertion depth; Quick-release seatpost clamp
Quick-release seatpost clamp for easy adjustments; Made from aluminum
SRAM X5 trigger shifter
Forged aluminum; CNC-machined; Handlebars attached via two clamps; Rise/drop: +/-15° with flip-flop design to adjust the handlebar height; Length: 50 mm

20 x 2.25″ Schwalbe Rocket Ron with ADDIX SPEED rubber compound; Quality mountain bike tires with low rolling resistance, maximum grip, good shock absorption, and excellent durability; Presta valves, tubeless conversion ready

Tubeless-compatible Alexrims wheelset; Aluminum hubs with sealed industrial bearings; Thru axles for maximum torsional strength (100 x 15 mm front and 135 x 12 mm rear); 20 G14 spokes, double-crossed spoking; Aluminum nipples
